Subject: Discovery recap + quick question on fit & timing

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick written recap so we have the same view and a short ask on next steps.

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: reduce per-query token cost for multi-turn product recommendations (site search / upsell) while keeping latency under 120ms p50.
- Current infra: in-house CPU inference for embeddings + a mix of GPU experiments; key blocker is unpredictable latency at peak traffic.
- Data constraints: PII redaction required; logs stored for 30 days, SOC2 in progress.
- Success metric: achieve 30–40% lower cost per effective query and maintain or improve end-user perceived latency.

Proposed next steps (from our side):
1) I can share a short proof-of-concept plan (2wk, one model + caching + traffic slice) and cost/latency projection.
2) Optional 15-min alignment call to lock timeline and stakeholders.
3) If fit looks good, we’d follow with a pilot scope and reserved capacity estimate.

Attachments: discovery_notes.pdf (2 page summary & quant assumptions).

Quick question: based on today’s priorities, where would this land on your roadmap (P0 / P1 / P2) for the next quarter? That helps me tailor the POC and timing.

If it’s easier, grab 15 minutes on my calendar: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/15min

Thanks — appreciate the candid feedback.

Best,
Ben Carter
